name: House of Dolls
source:
On his semester break, Reece Tyler visits the house he inherited from the estate of his late uncle (a doll-maker).

Inside, he learns of the doll-making legacy of the Tyler clan, the reason for the longstanding rift between his father and late uncle, and a little about himself.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28299]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
学期放假期间，里斯·泰勒参观了他从已故叔叔（玩偶制造商）的遗产中继承的房子。

在里面，他了解到泰勒家族的玩偶制作遗产、他父亲和已故叔叔之间长期不和的原因，以及一些关于他自己的事情。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28299]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
